name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor>: domain=cursor, descriptor=move_down. 'down' is the directional semantic (matches siblings move_up/move_left/move_right). No Ghidra address residue. Accurately reflects the down-arrow (scancode 0x50) battle cursor handler.
purpose: Down-arrow (scancode 0x50) battle cursor handler: moves the battle cursor one tile down, scrolling the viewport when needed, then refreshes the frame.
logic_summary: Vertical mirror of fd2_cursor_move_up. If cursor_world_y != map_height_tiles-1 (not at map bottom): when cursor_screen_y < 6 OR window_origin_y == map_height_tiles-8 (cursor in upper viewport portion, or view already at max downward scroll), step the cursor down on screen (cursor_world_y++, cursor_screen_y++) and return early if anim_phase==0 (main loop will redraw); else scroll the view down (cursor_world_y++, window_origin_y++). In all non-early-return paths call fd2_composite_battle_frame(0); the at-bottom no-op path still refreshes the frame.
